_howto: Leave 'url' empty until you have the official export link. Open https://resultsnd.sos.nd.gov/ , use its Exports menu, right-click the CSV (or JSON/XML) link, Copy Link Address, and paste it into 'url' below. Format 'auto' detects CSV vs JSON. If the CSV headers are unusual, name them in 'columns' (keys: contest, candidate, party, votes, reporting, totalPrecincts).
